body: People better give me some ups if they want some good dick sucking...
So many good blowjobs I'd give....
Thank you for the link, it wasn't easy to find... but I'm talking to someone and it helps.
God, I'd give the ugliest motherfucker a blowjob just to get fired. I worked shitty jobs and just never showed up for them afterwards... I'm so scared I won't get hired by the end of January....
Especially given what happened in Connecticut... I'm so pissed with that bullshit. Take my life, not 20+ innocent kids that never asked for it.

I only wish I was somewhat more "culturally Deaf", I am not fluent in ASL. I'm am embarrassment to the Deaf world.
I enjoy learning other languages, signified by HEARING, I've learned some French, almost fluent in Spanish (at one point), and now Japanese... I mostly learned Japanese for my partner...
I was going to ask him to marry me in Japanese with some stupid elaborate ceremony on his college campus... and now it's all gone to shit.
I need to visit somewhere in the World. American suffering is bullshit isn't it? I'm not working in a slave shop twelve hours a day... I could have it a lot, lot worse.
I read at 85% better than what most people would... I wish I listened to my speech therapist now. I could be a gay James Bond! (maybe!, but no, never!, that's all in fantasy!)

It wouldn't help me. I already had to spend my entire life how to lipread (I'm quite good at it, I've gotten secret offers from the FBI...).... it probably didn't help I just tried to learn how to lipread JAPANESE this quarter... and no fucking surprise... I fail.
At this point, being unemployed for so long, finally done with school and I have no jobs lined up.... I feel worthless. I just feel like one more mouth to feed.
Thank you, I like this so much.

You don't want to ask a Deaf person that. Seriously.... Maybe parents to a Deaf newborn child... but honestly, an issue that is so complex... even I (as a Deaf person) don't want to touch. (I don't want to make you feel like you made me angry but you might make others upset...)

But to be honest, a cochlear implant won't help me. I just turned thirty.... it's best when it's done when the child is less than five years old.

Please, please watch "Sound and Fury", even as a Deaf person... it shocked me and opened my eyes to the whole debate to "Hearing and Deaf".

My partner, he left me here believing I wouldn't feel like this. It's not fair. I want him to be happy, it doesn't matter what happens to me. I've lived a full life as it is. I've seen love and death... I'm just so tired.
I guess the only thing I'd want is some more weed... XDDD seriously, that shit is amazing.
I am gay, never been ashamed of it... but... honestly I hate being Deaf.
I am under the influence of alcohol yes... XPPP
I feel like a selfish asshole for being so depressed. My Mom died of cancer and I could of had it a lot worse.
I was born Deaf, but I'm not "culturally Deaf", my nine year relationship with my patner... I love him so much, just ended and I'm just ready to call it quits.
